description: The final check on a drafted plan: is it finished and ready to shoot? It returns ready or not ready, with a record of what was checked and what was not. A plan that does not pass gets a normal answer, not an error: the reasons are the next actions, each with its plan path and a fix. A pass is the result to show your human. It holds the plan to the format and to editing readiness, not to taste. No AI model runs. Input: plan, a dpl.plan/1 object. Output: dpl.draft-gate/1 with passed (true or false), result (ready_to_shoot or not_ready), the reasons and counts, and next_tool, the tool to call next. The engine's own wording may name its command line: ignore that and follow next_tool, which names the tool to call next and what to send. We don't keep the plan. We log a one-way fingerprint (hash) of it, its size, the tool, the type of client, the result and the time taken. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

name: shoot_plan_draft_gate
